processNotes: The manufactured frame and other manufactured subassemblies are supplied complete for this demonstration; purchased components are supplied ready to fit.
The historical record places product 754 at Final Assembly, location 60. The preceding Subassembly routing and the operations at both centers are inferred, not engineering specifications.
The direct BOM lists 1 EA of the pedal; the demonstration does not assume that this means a pair.

The snapshot does not establish every attachment or control detail. Stop and resolve missing compatibility or operating information rather than inventing hardware or treating the result as road-ready.
variantNotes: The representative is red, size 58, and uses frame FR-R72R-58.
The other supplied variants are also red: size 60 uses frame FR-R72R-60, size 44 uses FR-R72R-44, size 48 uses FR-R72R-48, and size 52 uses FR-R72R-52.

The supplied direct BOMs use the same other components and quantities across these variants, including front wheel FW-R762 and rear wheel RW-R762. Select the matching frame rather than substituting the size 58 frame.

100281.title: Road-450 overall fitting view
guidance: Support 1 EA of ML Road Frame - Red, 58 (Product Number FR-R72R-58) in an assumed assembly stand. The overall fitting relationships are shown in illustration 100281.
Fit 1 EA of ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451) at the frame steering area, then fit 1 EA of ML Road Handlebars (Product Number HB-R720); verify that steering moves freely.
Fit 1 EA of ML Road Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-R430) to the frame and check its alignment.
Fit 1 EA of ML Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-8107) and 1 EA of ML Crankset (Product Number CS-6583) at the frame's crank area using assumed hand tools; check for free movement.

Fit 1 EA of ML Road Front Wheel (Product Number FW-R762) at the front fork and 1 EA of ML Road Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-R762) at the rear of the frame; check that both rotate without visible interference.
